purpose: Paleo Lens for research findings before Psycle lesson decisions. Interesting research can be ignored if it is not actionable or safe.

items.title: Implementation intentions and goal achievement meta-analysis

critique.effect_size: Reported medium-to-large effect on goal attainment, d = .65, across 94 independent tests

items.decision_reason: Strong fit for work/study start-friction variants; use as if-then planning practice, not as a promise of guaranteed habit change.

items.title: AASM guideline on behavioral and psychological treatments for chronic insomnia disorder

critique.study_design: Clinical practice guideline based on systematic review and GRADE assessment
critique.effect_size: Strong recommendation for multicomponent CBT-I; conditional recommendations for stimulus control, sleep restriction, relaxation, and not using sleep hygiene alone
confounders: chronic insomnia differs from occasional poor sleep
sleep restriction can be unsafe without clinical guidance

items.decision_reason: Use to sharpen health_l01 boundaries: short lesson can explain stimulus control and relaxation options, but should not prescribe clinical sleep restriction.

items.title: Poverty-related concerns can consume cognitive capacity

critique.study_design: Experimental and field studies on financial concern and cognitive performance
critique.effect_size: Source reports reduced cognitive capacity under poverty-related concerns; exact app-use effect is not established
confounders: poverty context differs from ordinary consumer impulse
risk of overgeneralizing to all money decisions

items.decision_reason: Useful as an explanation for scarcity bandwidth in money_l01, but not enough to claim a simple shopping intervention changes financial outcomes.

items.title: Putting feelings into words: affect labeling and limbic response

critique.study_design: Functional MRI experiment comparing affect labeling with other encoding tasks
critique.effect_size: Source reports diminished amygdala and limbic response to negative emotional images during affect labeling
confounders: image labeling differs from real-life emotion regulation
neural response is not the same as durable behavior change

items.decision_reason: Good refresh for mental_l01/l03: teach short affect labeling as a first move, with conservative claims.

items.title: Self-compassion interventions for depressive symptoms, anxiety, and stress: meta-analysis

critique.effect_size: Small-to-medium immediate effects, smaller follow-up effects; source notes overall risk of bias across included RCTs was high
confounders: self-compassion can be misread as excusing behavior

items.decision_reason: Use to soften self-blame lessons and add return-after-lapse framing, but avoid therapy-like promises.
